mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 6 months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent demand weakness.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the past 3 months signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 2% does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 over the past month, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% over the past 3 months and real final sales (RSAFS) also decline, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent demand weakness.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals resilient supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent economic resilience during tightening cycles.
